question: Does the baseline completed-U1 photon+baryon+massless-UR+neutral-Khronon system possess a regular zero-charge adiabatic superhorizon branch whose O(k^2) gradient coefficients satisfy the preferred DAE constraints and determine B0 rather than prescribing chi/B?

mandatory_architecture.gravity_solve: preferred-coordinate finite-k DAE: A constraint -> Hamiltonian -> momentum; Newtonian/Stueckelberg potentials are outputs
mandatory_architecture.forbidden_newtonian_solve: do not globally invert the known crossing-prone Newtonian 3x3 basis
mandatory_architecture.chi_B: no independently integrated chi/B state and no convenience choice B0=0
mandatory_architecture.ordinary_variables: curvature-dressed physical-interface densities D_i=delta_i-3(1+w_i)Psi_N plus physical velocities/higher moments
mandatory_architecture.neutral_variables: preferred action-fluid delta_khr,theta_khr using phi_pref in Euler and k^2 B in continuity
mandatory_architecture.source_channels: ordinary-only deltaH0 for A filter; total density, pressure, anisotropic stress and momentum for metric/Ward equations

gradient_ansatz.higher_regular_multipoles: F_l=O(k^l) for l>=3, with the implemented hierarchy retaining every term needed through O(k^2)

adiabatic_branch_conditions.normalization: fix one nonzero overall curvature/density amplitude only; final rank statement must be invariant under this normalization
adiabatic_branch_conditions.photon_baryon_tight_coupling: use the actual early-time tight-coupling equations/limit; do not hard-code a finite-k equality beyond its controlled order
adiabatic_branch_conditions.neutral_charge: I_khr=delta_khr/(1+w_khr)-3 psi_pref=0 at the declared pre-EFT boundary
adiabatic_branch_conditions.neutral_velocity: must be solved; do not set theta_khr by copying an ordinary velocity or by convenience
adiabatic_branch_conditions.equivalent_B0_formula: B0=[C2+2 Pcal psi0-E_th phi0]/(2H), C2=3a^2 delta_mu2+3H Q2

ordinary_physical_interface_equations_re.continuity: use curvature-dressed continuity so explicit Psi_N' cancels; for constant-w collisionless/perfect components D_i'=-(1+w_i)theta_i plus the appropriate collision/source terms
ordinary_physical_interface_equations_re.Euler: ordinary species feel Phi_N and the physical Newtonian-coordinate shear-aware bridge, not phi_pref
ordinary_physical_interface_equations_re.UR: retain massless-UR anisotropic stress at O(k^2); it contributes at leading order to the potential relation because Pi~(rho+p)sigma/k^2 is finite
ordinary_physical_interface_equations_re.baryon_photon: retain the controlled tight-coupling momentum exchange needed at the chosen onset/order

metric_bridge_required.Phi_N: (1-Pcal)phi_pref+psi_pref+alpha1 L psi_pref-H B-8 pi G a^2 Pi_total
metric_bridge_required.warning: The diagnostic grid is not a fitted or UV-complete parameter selection.

preregistered_rank_tests: After removing one overall normalization, compute the rank/nullity of the complete O(k^0)+O(k^2) coefficient system.
A scoped growing-mode pass requires exactly one regular zero-charge adiabatic direction before normalization and no extra free B0/chi datum.
Verify B0 obtained from the momentum expansion equals the independent C10.55 C2 formula within symbolic zero or <=1e-10 relative numerical residual.
Verify every preferred A/H/M constraint residual is <=1e-10 in a numerical realization and no quantity diverges faster than its frozen k-scaling as k decreases.
Verify the finite-k preferred solve stays inside the already-certified nonzero-determinant domain; do not interpret the known Newtonian 3x3 crossing as physical rank loss.
Repeat at least the three frozen lambda_HL values and three M_c values from the diagnostic onset protocol; report parameter dependence without fitting.

baseline_control_policy.allowed: C10.65a historical CLASS values may be used only for regression of signs, normalization conventions and the zero-deformation/control limit.
baseline_control_policy.forbidden: Do not import historical CLASS psi/phi, B=0, theta_khr, or total source trajectory as the completed-U1 solution.
baseline_control_policy.reason: C10.65b must establish self-consistent completed metric feedback rather than replaying the action-fluid shadow.

background_scope_guard: The first implementation may use the pinned production background only as a diagnostic matching branch. It must label the result scoped until the independent same-full-action Friedmann/gravity-normalization gate is closed.

classification_rule.pass_scoped: regular coefficient system, exactly one zero-charge adiabatic growing direction modulo normalization, solved (not prescribed) neutral velocity and B0, B0 cross-check pass, preferred constraint residual/rank guards pass across the frozen diagnostic grid
classification_rule.nonunique_scoped: two or more regular zero-charge adiabatic directions remain after normalization
classification_rule.no_regular_branch_scoped: the frozen equations have no regular zero-charge adiabatic solution across the required grid
classification_rule.technical_incomplete: required hierarchy/source/constraint equations are not yet encoded self-consistently

non_claims: not a UV derivation of the zero-charge boundary
not completed-U1 spectra or likelihood evidence
next_if_pass: Implement the same coefficient/seed construction inside an opt-in completed-U1 Boltzmann shadow and run onset-shift plus spectra controls before any refit.
